title: LIQUID I.V. — BEACH DAY
lessons: The player notices Liquid I.V. because a seasonal flavor is built around a familiar candy or frozen-treat brand.
The player already uses Liquid I.V. and buys a variety pack instead of committing to one flavor.

text: The player notices Liquid I.V. because a seasonal flavor is built around a familiar candy or frozen-treat brand.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: You made hydration taste like a childhood freezer aisle.

entry-first-2.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: When you say it like that, yes.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: The familiar name is doing a lot of work.

entry-first-4.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: That is the point of the collaboration. Firecracker got attention because people recognized the memory before they understood the electrolyte powder.

choice-first.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: That sounds fun enough to try once.
Nostalgia has nothing to do with hydration.
I do not want candy logic in a wellness product.

first-1.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Then the memory got you to taste it.

first-1-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: I resent how effective that is.

first-2.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Correct. The familiar flavor gets you to look. The hydration product still has to earn the purchase.

first-3.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Then the collaboration is doing the opposite of what you want. Skip it.
The player already uses Liquid I.V. and buys a variety pack instead of committing to one flavor.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: I keep buying the variety pack and choosing the same two first.

entry-return-2.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: That still counts as variety. Technically.

entry-return-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: Why not just sell me those two?

entry-return-4.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: You can. The pack is there if changing flavors keeps the routine from getting stale.

choice-return.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I like being able to choose based on my mood.
This feels like a fix for getting bored with the product.
If I am bored enough to need four flavors, maybe I do not need the habit.

return-1.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Then the variety pack is earning its space in the cabinet.

return-2.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: It can be. Boredom is a real reason people stop repeating things.

return-3.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Also fair. A routine is allowed to end.
